title: After
description: Two people whom fate relentlessly brings together despite countless separations and new attempts to build a life apart.

title: The Hunger Games
description: A girl becomes involved in a deadly reality show where the participants must kill each other to survive.

title: Home Alone
description: A boy is accidentally left home alone for Christmas and hilariously defends his house from clumsy burglars.

title: Nerve
description: A shy girl joins an online game of “Truth or Dare,” where the challenges grow increasingly dangerous.

title: Pride and Prejudice
description: An intelligent and independent young woman clashes with a proud aristocrat, and their mutual dislike slowly turns into love.

title: Spider-Man
description: An ordinary guy gains superpowers after being bitten by a spider and becomes a hero protecting the city from villains.

title: Five Feet Apart
description: Two teenagers with a rare illness fall in love but must stay at least five feet apart to protect their lives.

title: Cruella
description: A young woman with a talent for fashion transforms into the bold and ruthless Cruella de Vil, determined to make her mark in a world of glamour and revenge.
